full_judgment: 10. Mr. Atikur Rahman, learned Advocate, for the appellant in both the appeals submits that since the writ petitions were not maintainable, the High Court Division erred in law in making the Rules Nisi absolute with direction upon the Adalat to amend the decree of the respective Artha Rin suit passed in the respective suit. In support of his contention, he referred the cases of Oriental Bank Ltd former Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Ltd vs AB Siddiq (Ludu), 13 BLC (AD) 144; Antibiotic Stores vs Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat 55 DLR (AD) 13: Gazi M Towfic vs Agrani Dank 54 DLR (AD) 6; Bangladesh Agriculture Development Corporation (BADC) vs Artha Rin Adalat, 59 DLR (AD) 6.
